title.en: A tech habit under the microscope
title.es: Un hábito digital bajo la lupa

es: Escribir un artículo de opinión sobre un hábito digital con dos causas, dos consecuencias y una predicción con matiz.

teaching.en: One cause is that many teenagers use screens until bedtime.
teaching.es: Una causa es que muchos adolescentes usan pantallas hasta la hora de dormir.
teaching.explanationEs: One cause is that … presenta la primera causa con una oración completa.
teaching.audioText: One cause is that many teenagers use screens until bedtime.

teaching.en: Another cause stems from notifications that keep arriving at night.
teaching.es: Otra causa proviene de las notificaciones que siguen llegando por la noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Another cause stems from + causa añade una segunda razón.
teaching.audioText: Another cause stems from notifications that keep arriving at night.

teaching.en: As a result, they sleep less, and this can lead to poor focus in class.
teaching.es: Como resultado, duermen menos, y esto puede llevar a una peor concentración en clase.
teaching.explanationEs: As a result introduce una consecuencia; can suaviza la afirmación.
segments: As a result, they sleep less, and this
can lead to poor focus in class.
teaching.audioText: As a result, they sleep less, and this can lead to poor focus in class.

teaching.en: Consequently, their marks may fall and they may not get enough rest.
teaching.es: En consecuencia, sus notas pueden bajar y puede que no descansen lo suficiente.
teaching.explanationEs: Consequently es un conector formal; may indica posibilidad, no certeza.
segments: Consequently, their marks may fall and
they may not get enough rest.
teaching.audioText: Consequently, their marks may fall and they may not get enough rest.

teaching.en: If this habit continues, it is likely that more teenagers will feel tired every day.
teaching.es: Si este hábito continúa, es probable que más adolescentes se sientan cansados cada día.
teaching.explanationEs: It is likely that + will da una predicción con matiz: likely es un adjetivo.
segments: If this habit continues, it is likely that
more teenagers will feel tired every day.
teaching.audioText: If this habit continues, it is likely that more teenagers will feel tired every day.

teaching.en: Unless families set rules, the problem will probably grow.
teaching.es: A menos que las familias pongan normas, el problema probablemente crecerá.
teaching.explanationEs: Unless equivale a if … not. Probably va entre will y el verbo.
teaching.audioText: Unless families set rules, the problem will probably grow.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Una causa es que muchos adolescentes usan pantallas hasta la hora de dormir.»

answer.text: One cause is that many teenagers use screens until bedtime

feedback.es: La primera causa se presenta con One cause is that + oración completa.

hint.es: Empieza con one cause is that.

feedback.es: As a result + coma introduce lo que pasa a consecuencia de la causa.

hint.es: Es el conector que presenta una consecuencia.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa la predicción con matiz?

choices.text: It is probably that more teenagers will sleep badly.
More teenagers will sleep badly for sure.
It is likely that more teenagers will sleep badly.

feedback.es: It is likely that + will da la predicción con matiz. It is probably es incorrecto y for sure la afirma sin matiz.

hint.es: Después de it is necesitas un adjetivo, no un adverbio.

origin.text: Quieres una predicción con matiz: es probable que más adolescentes duerman mal.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase presenta bien la segunda causa?

choices.text: Another cause stems from notifications at night.
Another cause stems of notifications at night.
Another cause gives rise from notifications at night.

feedback.es: Stem from + causa añade la segunda razón. Stems of y gives rise from no existen.

origin.text: Escribe la segunda causa: viene de las notificaciones de la noche.

prompt.es: Completa: «A menos que las familias pongan normas, el problema crecerá.»

feedback.es: Unless equivale a if … not y se usa con un verbo afirmativo: set.

origin.text: ___ families set rules, the problem will grow.

prompt.es: Escribe una consecuencia: dormir poco puede bajar las notas.

answer.text: As a result, their marks may fall.
accepted: As a result, their marks may fall.
As a result, their marks may get worse.

feedback.es: La consecuencia se abre con As a result o Consequently y se suaviza con may.

origin.text: Consecuencia: si duermen poco, sus notas pueden bajar.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la predicción con matiz del hablante.

choices.text: Their marks could get worse in the future.

feedback.es: El hablante usa may get worse: no asegura nada, solo dice que las notas podrían empeorar.

origin.audio: Many students study with their phones next to them. One result is poor focus, and in the long run their marks may get worse.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si este hábito continúa, probablemente más alumnos dormirán mal.»

answer.text: If this habit continues more students will probably sleep badly
accepted: If this habit continues more students will probably sleep badly
More students will probably sleep badly if this habit continues

feedback.es: Probably va entre will y el verbo, y la condición con if usa presente, no will.

prompt.es: Escribe tu artículo de opinión sobre las pantallas de noche.

answer.text: Screens at night are a serious problem for teenagers. One cause is that many of them use screens until bedtime. Another cause stems from notifications that keep arriving at night. As a result, they sleep less, and this can lead to poor focus in class. Consequently, their marks may fall and they may feel tired every day. If this habit continues, it is likely that more teenagers will get too little rest. Unless families set clear rules, the problem will probably grow. In my opinion, schools and families must talk about this habit now.
accepted: Screens at night are a serious problem for teenagers. One cause is that many of them use screens until bedtime. Another cause stems from notifications that keep arriving at night. As a result, they sleep less, and this can lead to poor focus in class. Consequently, their marks may fall and they may feel tired every day. If this habit continues, it is likely that more teenagers will get too little rest. Unless families set clear rules, the problem will probably grow. In my opinion, schools and families must talk about this habit now.

Using screens at night is a problem for many teenagers. One cause is that they use their phones until bedtime. Another cause is due to notifications that arrive late at night. As a result, they sleep less, which can lead to poor focus at school. Consequently, their marks may get worse and they may feel tired all day. It is likely that more teenagers will feel tired if nothing changes. Unless families make clear rules, the problem will probably get bigger. I think everyone should talk about this habit now.

feedback.es: Un artículo completo tiene una tesis, dos causas, dos consecuencias y una predicción con matiz o una condición.

origin.text: Escribe un artículo de opinión de unas 100 palabras sobre las pantallas por la noche. Tesis: es un problema para los adolescentes. Causas: usan pantallas hasta la hora de dormir; las notificaciones llegan por la noche. Consecuencias: duermen menos; les cuesta concentrarse en clase. Predicción con matiz: si las familias no ponen normas, el problema probablemente crecerá.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase conecta bien una causa con su consecuencia?

choices.text: Late notifications stem from less sleep.
Late notifications are due to less sleep.
Late notifications lead to less sleep.

feedback.es: Las notificaciones tardías son la causa y menos sueño la consecuencia. Las otras dos frases invierten la relación.

origin.text: Causa: las notificaciones tardías. Consecuencia: duermen menos.

prompt.es: Completa: «Es probable que más alumnos se sientan cansados.»

feedback.es: It is likely that + will introduce una predicción con matiz; tras it is va el adjetivo likely.

origin.text: It is ___ that more students will feel tired.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué prevé el hablante.

choices.text: Teenagers will probably keep sleeping badly if nothing changes.
Teenagers will sleep well very soon.
Schools will surely change the start time.

feedback.es: Unless equivale a if not: si el horario no cambia, probablemente seguirán durmiendo mal.

origin.audio: Unless schools change the start time, teenagers will probably keep sleeping badly.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase con unless está bien formada?

choices.text: Unless we don't act, the habit will grow.
Unless we act, the habit will grow.
Unless we will act, the habit grows.

feedback.es: Unless ya contiene la negación y va con presente; con don't se duplicaría, y will tras unless no se usa.
